column1: # Yoshi and the Mysterious Book (Switch 2): the survey's profile (scripts/build_ipa_from_nsp.py, dm/games/profile_guess.py), unchanged by the bring-up (README.md)
# not loaded, main takes nothing from them the host does not supply: subsdk0 (C / libc), subsdk1 (C / libc)

# Unreal: nninitStartup reserves a 62 GB address region and its FMallocBinned3 takes 37 GB of it, so a 64 GB alias region for the bring-up on the Mac. The rewriter cuts the allocator in any Unreal 4 / 5 main (dm/tools/ue_malloc.py) and gives the region what the alias region has room for (dm/tools/ue_region.py), so an iPhone takes a smaller guest block, as Octopath Traveler 0's profile (docs/reference/memory.md)
# the sdk is built for the Switch 2 (spec: Ounce): its 9 GB pool
# the NPDM declares 20 MB of system resource
# the decoded shader code archives: the engine's global shaders and the game's material shaders
# the game calls nvnDeviceSetDepthMode with near = 0 in the check boot: the pipeline bases made before it runs are made for that mode

# address regions: 2026-11-03, in its first 15 s in nnMain the game's regions reach alias +63.00 GB, within the profile's 64.00 GB alias region (what it takes later in play is not measured here) (rewrite 99b5b46306c0)
